title: Does a world model remove the need for human oversight?
summary: No; higher-stakes world-model use requires stronger human oversight.
body: No. Internal reasoning remains only partly interpretable, prediction can be wrong and simulation may diverge from reality. Human oversight becomes more important as stakes and action consequences increase.
